benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Verify player initial spawn position is on a grassy surface
Preconditions: Game is loaded and displaying the start screen.
Steps:
  1. Click the “✦ Enter the Dream ✦” button to enter the game. -> expected: Game enters first-person view, player is positioned on the generated terrain.
  2. Observe the block type 1-2 blocks directly below and around the player. -> expected: Block directly below is grass or dirt, player is not clipped inside a block or floating in void.
Pass: Player spawns on grass/dirt block without clipping or spawning in void.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: Player spawns on grass/dirt block without clipping or spawning in void.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Verify block break and place interaction with inventory sync
Preconditions: Game is running with mouse pointer locked.
Steps:
  1. Aim crosshair at a visible block, hold left mouse button (LMB) until break animation completes. -> expected: Target block disappears with particle burst effect, block name displays below crosshair.
  2. Aim crosshair at adjacent face, hold right mouse button (RMB) to place selected hotbar block. -> expected: New block appears on adjacent face, hotbar slot count decreases by 1, crosshair shows new block name.
Pass: Break and place operations execute successfully, block state updates in real-time, inventory counts accurately decrement/increment.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: Break and place operations execute successfully, block state updates in real-time, inventory counts accurately decrement/increment.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Verify seamless infinite world loading and unloading
Preconditions: Game is running with mouse pointer locked.
Steps:
  1. Walk continuously in a single direction for at least 100 block distances. -> expected: New terrain generates continuously, distant terrain loads without pop-in, FPS remains stable, no console errors.
Pass: New chunks continuously generate beyond world boundary, old chunks auto-unload, movement is smooth without stutter or crash.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: New chunks continuously generate beyond world boundary, old chunks auto-unload, movement is smooth without stutter or crash.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Verify UI tool real-time world texture and theme changes
Preconditions: Game is running.
Steps:
  1. Press “I” to open Imagination panel, drag “Hue”, “Saturation”, or “Dreaminess” sliders. -> expected: Entire world block textures change color and pattern in real-time following sliders, top theme tag updates synchronously.
Pass: Textures update globally and synchronously, no flickering or partial updates, UI feedback matches visual changes.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: Textures update globally and synchronously, no flickering or partial updates, UI feedback matches visual changes.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Verify structure editor save, reload, and stamp
Preconditions: Game is running.
Steps:
  1. Press “B” to open structure editor, draw several blocks in 3D grid, click “Save” to enter name and save. -> expected: Save success toast appears, editor closes.
  2. Refresh browser page to reload game, press “B” again to open editor, click “Load” to select saved structure, click “Stamp”. -> expected: Structure data loads correctly, structure preview generates at crosshair, clicking places blocks in world according to design layout.
Pass: Structure successfully persists to IndexedDB, data survives page refresh, loads correctly and places into world.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: Structure successfully persists to IndexedDB, data survives page refresh, loads correctly and places into world.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Verify post-processing effects react to texture changes
Preconditions: Game is running.
Steps:
  1. Press “T” to trigger “Shift Reality”, observe screen visual effects. -> expected: Purple screen flash occurs, Bloom and chromatic aberration intensity changes noticeably, particle colors shift synchronously.
Pass: Post-processing effects and particle systems make real-time, observable visual responses to texture/theme switches.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: Post-processing effects and particle systems make real-time, observable visual responses to texture/theme switches.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Verify first-person movement, jumping, crouching, and collision
Preconditions: Game is running with mouse pointer locked.
Steps:
  1. Press W/A/S/D to move, Space to jump, C to crouch, walk towards a wall. -> expected: Movement is smooth, jump height is reasonable, eye level lowers when crouching, movement stops at wall without clipping.
Pass: All movement state switches work normally, physics collision accurately prevents clipping, eye level changes correctly with crouch.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: All movement state switches work normally, physics collision accurately prevents clipping, eye level changes correctly with crouch.

benchmark_checklist.checking_content:
Verify HUD display and pause menu functionality
Preconditions: Game is running.
Steps:
  1. Observe screen-edge HUD, press Esc to open pause menu, click “Settings”, toggle “Bloom” or adjust “Volume” slider. -> expected: HUD displays health, imagination bar, hotbar, and theme tag. Settings panel opens, adjusted items apply in real-time or prompt save.
  2. Click “Reset Dreamscape”, confirm reset. -> expected: World terrain and texture theme regenerate, player returns to newly generated grassy surface, HUD state resets.
Pass: HUD information is complete and accurate, settings panel is interactive and parameters apply, reset function fully rebuilds world and safely returns to game state.
benchmark_checklist.expected_result: HUD information is complete and accurate, settings panel is interactive and parameters apply, reset function fully rebuilds world and safely returns to game state.
